description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring and managing GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnels, including setup, teardown, and initialization for IPv4 and IPv6 variants, as used in OpenWRT network configurations.

methods.name: gre_generic_setup
methods.description: Configures a generic GRE tunnel with specified parameters, including JSON configuration and tunnel options.

methods.name: gre_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRE tunnel with IPv4, resolving peer address and handling network dependencies.

methods.name: proto_gre_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to call gre_setup with 'greip' mode.

methods.name: proto_gretap_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRETAP tunnel, including network interface configuration.

methods.name: grev6_setup
methods.description: Configures an IPv6 GRE tunnel, resolving IPv6 peer address and network dependencies.

methods.name: proto_grev6_setup
methods.description: Wrapper to call grev6_setup with 'greip6' mode.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_setup
methods.description: Sets up a GRETAP IPv6 tunnel, including network interface configuration.

methods.name: gretap_generic_teardown
methods.description: Removes devices associated with a GRETAP tunnel.

methods.name: gre_generic_init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration options for GRE tunnels.

methods.name: proto_gre_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options specific to GRE.

methods.name: proto_grev6tap_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for GREv6 TAP.
